# Welcome to ZeaZ Provider Discussions

This is a community space for discussions about ZeaZ Provider. Please follow our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in all interactions.

## Categories

### 📢 Announcements
Official announcements about releases, updates, and important project news.

### 💬 General Discussion
General conversations about ZeaZ Provider, use cases, and community topics.

### ❓ Q&A
Ask questions and get help from the community.

### 💡 Ideas
Share your ideas for new features or improvements.

### 🐛 Bug Reports
For actual bug reports, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zeaz/provider/issues) instead.

### 🎯 Show and Tell
Share what you've built with ZeaZ Provider!

---

## Before Posting

1. **Search first**: Check if your topic has already been discussed.
2. **Be respectful**: Follow our Code of Conduct.
3. **Use the right category**: Post in the appropriate category.
4. **Provide context**: When asking for help, include relevant details.

## Getting Help

For immediate support needs:
- Check our [SUPPORT.md](../SUPPORT.md) guide
- Review the [README.md](../README.md) for quick start instructions
- Browse existing [Issues](https://github.com/zeaz/provider/issues)

Thank you for being part of the ZeaZ Provider community!
